backbone.feature_source: model.get_intermediate_layers(x, n=1, norm=True)[0] (final block, LayerNorm applied)
backbone.input_size: Resize(short side = 448, BICUBIC, antialias=True), then crop to a multiple of 14 -> 448x448 for M2AD 1024x1024 sources

detector.bank: M2AD: 300 normal reference images per category/seed (bank_for); RobustAD: 180 source-train normals (documented bank-size constraint)
detector.distance: cosine distance = 1 - max cosine similarity (features L2-normalized)
detector.score_aggregation: image score = max over 1024 patch distances (1-NN-max)
detector.implementation: pure PyTorch matmul over bank chunks (scripts/e11_p2_runner.py:116-135); no FAISS/sklearn
detector.labels_and_filter: labels from the dataset's official `image_anomaly`; rows with `detectable == False` are dropped (e11_p2_runner.py:142)

r1_ila.formula: z' = z + W z  (adapter_forward, e13a_screen.py:154-155; LinearAdapter.forward returns Wz)
r1_ila.L_cons: 1 - mean_patch cos(l2norm(z_adapt(x)), l2norm(z_adapt(T(x)))) (both sides adapted; e13a_screen.py:223-227)
r1_ila.L_preserve: 1 - mean_patch cos(l2norm(z_adapt(x)), l2norm(z_frozen(x))); frozen side detached
r1_ila.beta_injection: module-level global read by compute_loss (no frozen code edited)

training.optimizer_note: only lr is passed explicitly; betas/eps/weight_decay are PyTorch defaults (torch.optim.AdamW defaults at torch 2.8.0)
training.early_stopping_criterion: validation consistency term only (L_cons, NOT the total loss), averaged over 60 held-out normals x all 6 variants (val_adapter_loss, e13a_screen.py:320-338); improvement threshold 1e-6; stop after 30 steps without improvement
training.checkpoint_policy: NO best-checkpoint restore: the parameters at the stopping iteration are scored (see results/e26/checkpoint_audit/REPORT.md)

random_seeds.note: seed controls adapter init/training RNG only; bank per seed

augmentation.brightness: x * level on the [0,1] tensor then clamp(0,1)
augmentation.probability: no Bernoulli gate: every training step samples one variant index uniformly per image from the 6 precomputed variants (train_aug[idx, aidx])
augmentation.order: perturbation applied BEFORE ImageNet normalization; all 6 variants precomputed once per bank image
augmentation.detail: NOT a random photometric jitter at each step: the 6 variants are fixed tensors reused across steps (e13a_screen.py:59-64, 179-186)

input_cache.note: 9 of 10 categories have no extracted originals on this server; E22/E26 read the 448 cache (short side 448, BICUBIC, antialias, PNG uint8)

robustad.splits: per-subdataset metadata.jsonl (labels never taken from directory names)
robustad.split_generation: upstream RobustAD (AmazonScience) split directories, unmodified; MetalParts test0 excluded (valid=0) by the E25 protocol
